احتوشتا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَوَشَتَا (iḥtawašatā) /iħ.ta.wa.ʃa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِحْتَوَشَ (iḥtawaša)
# اُحْتُوِشَتَا (uḥtuwišatā) /uħ.tu.wi.ʃa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِحْتَوَشَ (iḥtawaša)
